facts.fact: Ley Núm. 1/2016 of 22 July 2016, sanctioned and promulgated by the President, sets rules for personal data processing in the public and private sectors and enters into force twenty days after its publication in the Boletín Oficial del Estado (date taken from the law's own date, 22 July 2016).

facts.fact: Articles 15 and 29 name the Órgano Rector de Protección de Datos Personales as the supervisory body, with a Secretaría Técnica and a Registro General under it, but state that it is to be created by a decree that will fix its structure.

Chamber of Deputies approved the proposal to ratify the Malabo Convention on 2026-03-25; a parliamentary approval is neither signature nor ratification, so no treaty value fits.
Interministerial council considered a proposal to authorise the Malabo Convention on 2025-11-19; a proposal under discussion is neither signature nor ratification.

facts.fact: The African Union Infrastructure and Energy Department reports that Equatorial Guinea's foreign minister signed the Malabo Convention in Addis Ababa on 28 July 2026, as a step towards ratification.
The African Union's status list of 2 February 2026 records no signature and no ratification of the Malabo Convention by Equatorial Guinea.
